learner_operation: Identify inner polynomial u and outer exponent +1/2 or -1/2; differentiate each, multiply, simplify, and where requested substitute x0. Select the matching expression or enter an equivalent expression.

fixed_features.feature: Outer function is square root or reciprocal square root; inner polynomial degree at most two
fixed_features.justification: Lesson e-182, q-48730 and q-342680 establish this chain-rule depth; sum term only in q-20181.

fixed_features.feature: Finite real slope and simple square radicand for evaluated questions
fixed_features.justification: Source slopes all evaluate at positive square radicands. Avoiding undefined roots preserves the stated derivative task and arithmetic workload.

fixed_features.feature: One correct expression in a five-option radio or equivalent-expression blank
fixed_features.justification: Captured field contracts; zero-total radio bank must be rejected to keep five distinct choices.
No defensible instructional reason found. Author cites q-342680 shape, but the central lesson e-182 uses 1-x^2 with a nonzero constant and no linear term. This fixed assignment fails review.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Either sign and bounded magnitudes without changing chain-rule method
answer_roles.observed: Both coefficient signs in every sampled template; details in coverage.json.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Square root and reciprocal square root follow +1/2 versus -1/2 rules
answer_roles.observed: Same inner 6x-3 pair changes derivative from -3/(6x-3)^(3/2) to 3/sqrt(6x-3).

answer_roles.role: evaluated slope sign/zero and target point
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Hold curve fixed and vary valid x0; positive, zero, negative all legitimate
answer_roles.observed: -x^2+10x at targets 2,5,8 gives 3/4,0,-3/4. Both quadratic blank samplers include negative, zero, positive in fresh samples.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Every displayed position and eligible scalar rank; no source answer position is essential
answer_roles.observed: Rank and displayed-position counts vary. No perfect incidental cue found in tested raw, filtered or selected groups.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Canonical 1-x^2 and practice x^2-6x both require one polynomial derivative and one chain-rule multiplication
answer_roles.observed: Generator forbids nonzero quadratic constants outside constant-quadratic slope template; canonical derivative cannot be generated.

answer_roles.role: radical contribution versus cubic contribution in total slope
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Distractors should require the learner to calculate the radical chain-rule contribution rather than identify the polynomial derivative approximately.
answer_roles.observed: FAIL: whole-slope scaling spaces options so widely that ignoring the radical gives a perfect nearest-cubic predictor in a recognizable subgroup.

coverage.result: All 5 pass shared delivery; 3 radio and 2 reciprocal blank records.
FAIL: explicit a=-1,b=0,c=1 rejected before rendering.

coverage.case: dominating cubic shortcut across every bank role
coverage.result: 20/20 shortcut successes. These are ordinary sampler-range parameters in the supported easy family, not out-of-scope constructed expressions.

counterfactuals.change: Hold -x^2+10x fixed; change target 2 to 5 to 8
counterfactuals.expected: Slope changes 3/4 to 0 to -3/4; former answers stop grading correct
counterfactuals.observed: Matching prompts, substitutions, rendered answers and native accepted canonical/equivalent entries; six cross-target responses rejected.
counterfactuals.justification: q-342792 and q-342789 require evaluating the derivative at a specified point. Targets 5 and 8 are explicit same-method controls outside normal t bound.

counterfactuals.change: Hold a=-4, root family and display seed fixed; shift constant 3 to 7
counterfactuals.expected: Inner derivative stays -4; denominator, prompt and solution change together
counterfactuals.observed: 2/sqrt((-4x+3)^3) changes to 2/sqrt((-4x+7)^3); actual canonical and scaled equivalents accepted, matching visible solutions.
counterfactuals.justification: Inner constant affects composition value, not inner derivative, exactly the separation taught in e-182.

counterfactuals.change: Hold inner 6x-3 fixed; swap root versus reciprocal root
counterfactuals.expected: Reconsider outer power and sign; derivative changes
counterfactuals.observed: -3/(6x-3)^(3/2) versus 3/sqrt(6x-3), correct radio IDs accepted and four wrong choices rejected for each.
counterfactuals.justification: q-48730 versus q-107303 requires different outer power derivatives.

counterfactuals.change: Reverse the same radio choices without altering math, key or explanation
counterfactuals.expected: Correct mathematical value and native accepted choice UUID remain; screen position changes
counterfactuals.observed: Response 3/sqrt(6x-3) unchanged; choices reversed, actual grader accepts same UUID and rejects the other four; renderer passes.
counterfactuals.justification: Choice ordering does not enter the chain rule or source mathematical task.

counterfactuals.change: Use canonical e-182 constant-quadratic radicand 1-x^2 in derivative template
counterfactuals.observed: ValueError: Observed quadratic scope has two nonconstant terms and c=0
counterfactuals.justification: e-182 is the central radical chain-rule lesson example. Its constant assignment is not an extra prerequisite.
